title: Intentional photographs
summary: Connect capture choices to deliberate composition in a short unrelated learning path.
outcomes: Explain motion and exposure choices, then make a frame communicate a subject.
startingAssumptions: No camera is required; the fictional written scenes are enough.

groups.title: Choose the capture
groups.purpose: Separate light from rendered brightness and deliberate motion.

groups.title: Choose the frame
groups.purpose: Connect subject emphasis to what is included and excluded.

playbooks.title: A moving subject looks blurred
playbooks.summary: Return to the canonical shutter explanation and practise making a capture decision.

targets.label: Reason through motion and shutter duration
